violations.why: irq_vine can preempt fn_delta between the two reads of v_larch and write it, so the reads can see different values.
After irq_flint sets v_walnut to 0, irq_nectar can preempt main between the two reads of v_loom and write it.
irq_vine (higher priority) can preempt irq_lantern after it writes 42 and before it reads v_velvet back. irq_vine rewrites v_velvet at line 167 and again through fn_tide.
irq_vine calls fn_tide, which resets v_velvet to 0. If that happens between irq_lantern's write of 42 and its read, the check at line 159 fails.
